blocks.text: DAVAO CITY — A French Navy vessel, FS Vendemiaire F-734, visited this city on Monday as part of the Visiting Forces Agreement (VFA) with the Philippines. It arrived around 9 a.m. at the Sasa Port in this city. The Naval Forces Eastern Mindanao (NFEM) welcomed the vessel, a Floreal-class frigate, and its crew. READ: France today,
